paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
heading: Piang Masa Latna

paite: "Piang masapen tengteng, Israel suante lak a sul hong peuhmah, mihing hi in ganta hitaleh siangthou in sehtuamsak in, kei' a ahi," achi hi.

Mosi in mite kiang ah, "Hiai ni theigige un, Aigupta gam a pan na hong pawtkhiak ni uh, saltanna inn a pan na hong pawtkhiak ni uh ahi; TOUPA'N khut thahat a hiai mun hon tun lah ahi ngal a. Tanghou silngou soh nek louh ding ahi.
heading: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang

paite: Hiai ni, Abib kha in na hong paikhia uhi.

Hichi ahong hi ding a, TOUPA'N Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Hivte leh Jebuste gam nou hon piak dia, na pipute uh kiang a, akichiamna, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luang gam ahon tut chiang in, hiai biakna thilzek hiai kha in na tang ding uhi.
Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ua, ani sagih ni in TOUPA a ding in ankuangluina a-om ding ahi.
Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh akine dia; na kiang uah tanghou silngou soh akimu ding ahi kei. Na omna tengteng uah leng silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei hi.
Huai ni in na tapa na hilh ding a, 'Aigupta gam a pan ka hong paikhiak lai a TOUPA'N kei a dia athilhih ziak a hiai kihih ahi' na chi ding hi.
Na ban ah nang a ding in chiamtehna ahi dia, na mitte kikal ah theihgigena, huchi a na kam a TOUPA dan a-omtheihna ding in TOUPA'N ban thahat a Aigupta gam a pan noute ahon pikhiak ziak in.
Huaiziak in kum teng in ahunbi in hiai dan thuseh na zui ding uh ahi."
"Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N, nang kiang leh na pipute kiang a, akichiam bang a, Kanaante gam ahon tut chiang in, hiai ahon piak chiang in,
heading: Piang Masa

paite: TOUPA a ding in sul hong tengteng na koihtuam ding a, na neih ganta a pan hong om, anou masapen teng; apate TOUPA a ahi ding uhi.
Sabiltungnou masapen teng belamnou in na tankhe dia; huchi a na tatkhiak keileh, angawng na hektan ding. Na tapate lak a mihing tapa masa tengteng na tankhe ding ahi.

Hun hong tung ding ah hichi ahi ding a, na tapa in, 'hiai bang ahia? chi a hon dot chiang in, nang akiang ah, ban thahat in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan, koltanna inn a pan ahon lakheta' akiang ah na chi ding uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in genhaktak a hon paisak nop louh lai in, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, mihing apiang masate leh ganta apiang masate athat hi. Huaiziak in pasal, sul hong tengteng, TOUPA kiang a ka lat ahi ua; himahleh ka tapate lak a piang masa tengteng ka tankhia hi.
Huchi in na khut ah chiamtehna ding ahi dia, na mitte kikal a khaukhip ahi ding; TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ban thahat a ahon pikhiak ziak in," na chi ding hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh in huai mite apaisak lai in, naizaw mahleh Pathian in Philistiate gam tawn in api kei hi. Pathian in, "Kidouna amuh chiang un mite akisik kha ding ua, Aigupta gam ah akiheikik kha ding uh," achih ziak in.
heading: Meipi Leh Meikuang

paite: Huchi in Pathian in mite apikual a, Tuipi San gamdai lampi tawn in api hi. Huchibang in Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawlpawl a kizom in apaitou uhi.
Mosi in Joseph guhte apua hi. "Pathian in pel lou in ahong veh dia; hiai a pan ka guhte na puak ding uh ahi," chi a Israel suante chihtaktak a, akichiam ziak in.
Sukkoth a pan azinkheta ua, gamdai zul ah, Etham mun ah agiak uhi.

TOUPA ama uah sun in meipi khuampi dingh in, amaute lampi a pi ding in apai a; zan in meikuang khuampi dingh in, amaute vakna pe ding in; sun leh zan in apai hi; huchi a sun leh zan a apaitheihna ding un.
Mite ma a pan sun a meipi khuampi dingh hiam ahihkeileh zan a meikuang khuampi dingh alamang ngei kei hi.
